test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting in a line facing West. Gaurav is sitting at the third place to the left of Meenal. Varun is sitting between Vasu and Meenal. Poorvi is third to the right of Varun. Lalit is sitting to the immediate right of Meenal. Gaurav is sitting at one of the corners. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Poorvi?
solution:
Six friend facing west: Gaurav,meenal,Varun, Vasu, Lalit, Poorvi

1) Gaurav is sitting at one of the corners

2) Gaurav is sitting at the third place to the left of Meenal.

. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9f4bf44360e0e8c01d9dcc361f2f7ebed7edff13d717d6bf58cedb660b4a260.png] 

3) Lalit is sitting to the immediate right of Meenal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de1af73e06c97a7596e5b852d85c35a883361ec26e6740820f9adf3d5a41dcaf.png] 

4) Varun is sitting between Vasu and Meenal.

5) Poorvi is third to the right of Varun.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20f976e649b3e388e0cf1311afda8e58e84e5c4fc71c494d606051bfaa67f67e.png] 

Hence, “Lalit” is sitting to the immediate left of Poorvi.
